chunks: O YOU PEOPLE, fear your Lord. The great upheaval of the Hour will indeed be terrible.

key_terms.السَّاعَةِ: The Hour, referring to the time of resurrection or the Day of Judgment

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the earthquake of the Hour mentioned in Surah Al-Hajj?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the universal call to God-consciousness (Taqwa) amidst the cosmic tremors of the Hour, often linked with the concept of *Qiyamah* as a time of reckoning for all creation. The 'great thing' (*shay' 'azim*) underscores the severity of the event, serving as a spiritual wake-up call for believers to prepare through righteous deeds and adherence to the Ahl al-Bayt's teachings.
